newsitem.title: USA: Around $2 bln in U.S. corporate bonds expected.
newsitem.headline: Around $2 bln in U.S. corporate bonds expected.

text.p: U.S. corporate bond issuance for this week is expected to reach a climax on Thursday as issuers prepare to price around $2 billion in high-grade and junk bonds, syndicate officials said.

"The new issue market is not as hot as it was several weeks ago," said one syndicate source. "The market is looking at (deals) on a credit-by-credit basis. Good deals will be well-subscribed while poor ones will price wide."
Market players said corporations are likely to sell $1 billion in new high-grade bonds and around $900 million in junk bonds on Thursday.
